audit_metadata.title: DocSense Comprehensive End-to-End Quality, RAG & Security Audit Report

executive_summary.verdict_rationale: DocSense demonstrates exceptional UI/UX elegance, accurate single-document scoping (100%), and flawless negative rejection/anti-hallucination behavior (0% hallucination rate). However, it is blocked from production readiness by critical architectural resilience defects: unhandled Groq API rate limits (TPM 429) causing FastAPI HTTP 500 crashes, Windows console CP1252 Unicode crashes, unhandled PyMuPDF corrupt file exceptions with Windows file-lock PermissionErrors, insecure wildcard CORS with credentials, and severe synchronous queuing under concurrency.

top_risks.title: Unhandled LLM Rate Limits (Groq 429 TPM) Crashes Backend
top_risks.impact: answer_generator() in retrieval.py lacks retry logic and exponential backoff. When Groq tokens-per-minute threshold is reached under normal user queries or concurrency, FastAPI crashes with HTTP 500, destroying user session state.

top_risks.title: Windows Console Unicode CP1252 Crash
top_risks.impact: main.py line 164 executes print(index, session_data) inside /ask. When LLM output contains Unicode non-breaking hyphens (U+2011) or typographical spaces (U+202F), default Windows consoles crash with unhandled UnicodeEncodeError.

top_risks.title: Corrupt Upload File Lock & Denial of Service
top_risks.impact: PyMuPDF FileDataError raises an exception during ingestion, and the except block attempts file_path.unlink() while PyMuPDF still holds an open file handle, triggering Windows PermissionError [WinError 32] and leaving corrupt locked files on disk.

rag_metrics.evaluation_methodology: Semantic Equivalence & Fact Verification (accommodating typographical whitespace and Markdown styling)

concurrency_benchmark.failure_cause: Groq RateLimitError 429 TPM exceeded -> unhandled exception in answer_generator() -> HTTP 500

bug_register.title: Windows Console UnicodeEncodeError crashes /ask endpoint
bug_register.description: print(index, session_data) dumps LLM reasoning and response directly to stdout. In Windows environments with CP1252 encoding, characters like '\u2011' cause fatal 500 crashes.
bug_register.remediation: Replace raw print() with structured logger using sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') or utf-8 encoded handlers.

bug_register.title: Missing Rate-Limit Retry in answer_generator() causes HTTP 500
bug_register.description: query_enhancer() implements 5 retries, but answer_generator() has 0 retries. Any Groq 429 TPM rate limit immediately throws groq.RateLimitError and crashes the endpoint with HTTP 500.
bug_register.remediation: Implement tenacity retry decorator with exponential backoff on groq.RateLimitError and groq.APIError.

bug_register.title: Unhandled PyMuPDF FileDataError and WinError 32 file lock on corrupt upload
bug_register.description: Corrupt binary PDF causes PyMuPDFLoader to raise FileDataError. Ingestion fails and cleanup unlink() crashes with PermissionError: [WinError 32] because the file descriptor was not closed.
bug_register.remediation: Wrap PyMuPDF loader in try/finally, explicitly close document handle before attempting file deletion, and return HTTP 422 instead of crashing.

bug_register.title: Insecure Wildcard CORS combined with Credentials Allowed
bug_register.description: CORSMiddleware is initialized with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True. Modern browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins, and it exposes the API to CSRF risks.
bug_register.remediation: Specify explicit allowed origins from environment variable (e.g. ['http://localhost:5173']).

bug_register.title: Synchronous Thread Pool Exhaustion under Concurrency
bug_register.description: def chat() is defined as a synchronous function that blocks the thread pool during LLM inference (20-40s per query). 5 concurrent requests queue up and trigger client ReadTimeout.
bug_register.remediation: Migrate to async Groq client (AsyncGroq) and make endpoint async def chat() to allow non-blocking event-loop scheduling.

bug_register.title: Swallowed Exceptions in Existing Test Suite
bug_register.description: TC-07 in existing suite treats HTTP 500 on corrupt file upload as a pass. TC-16 asserts status_code == 200 without checking if hallucination occurred.
bug_register.remediation: Update test assertions to enforce strict HTTP status validation and factual assertion checking.

bug_register.title: Typographical Space Normalization Mismatch in Fact Extraction
bug_register.description: LLM emits narrow no-break space (U+202F) or non-breaking space (U+00A0) in dates and numbers (e.g. '18\u202fNovember\u202f2026', '320\u202fMW'), causing naive downstream matching to fail.
bug_register.remediation: Apply unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text) on generated answers prior to response serialization.
